Summary of what was saved:
- A new "Variant" section distinguishing "amount scheduled to mature IN calendar year Y" (read the all-securities total maturing in that year from the end-of-Month schedule) from the fixed/callable type-subtotal reading the skill previously only covered.

Both are concrete and reusable; not per-question trivia.
